verdict.rationale: Mercury's own pages document banking (checking, savings, treasury), spend management (cards, limits, reimbursements, approvals 'all in one place'), AI bill pay, and invoicing within one account. A long-time customer independently confirms running cards and accounts on Mercury. Missing for 10: in-depth documentation of the bill-pay workflow beyond a marketing line, and independent or hands-on evidence that founders actually retired separate spend and bill-pay tools.

support.subject: As a founder, I can replace multiple point solutions for spend, bill pay, and banking with one consolidated platform
